design_review.temporal_necessity: Pause between cue and food for prediction; compare with cue-alone test.
design_review.static_alternative_limitation: A static chart describes categories; it does not enact the prediction pause. Prefer static for labels alone.
design_review.narration_synchrony: Each state has an adjacent synchronized caption; no generated audio.
design_review.measurement_warning: Timings are display settings, not empirical intervals or learning thresholds.

motion_contract.reduced_motion: static wave/food/response states; no oscillation or particle travel
motion_contract.timing: schematic display timings, not measured experiment intervals
